1 Chromoss Module -> Mossy Cobblestonebuilt-in
$253.2k $1.14M +$883.18k/hr Three bone meal chains behind a Use Cheaper box — bone block ×9, bone ×3, and bone meal outright. They sit within ~6% of each other, so the winner genuinely flips with the market; the throughput cap lives on the logic box, not on the individual chains. Moss exit: selling moss blocks raw is $14.00 vs crafting to mossy cobblestone at $24.00 − $2.00 cobble = $22.00. Crafting wins by 36%. Mossy cobblestone's NPC worth ($24) sits above its best order bid, so its demand is ∞ npc and this chart has no Maximum bound at all.
Piglin Barter▲ 1built-in
$1.32M $2.2M +$876.61k/hr Note that piglin bartering is not a well tracked process and will often say that the "longest run" is very short. This is primarily due to there being small demand for the lesser-valued items such as ender pearls or iron nuggets. This is just an example of what can be done.⚠ no sell price for Splash Potion

Pink Petal Farm — 1 dispenser @ 4gt▲ 1built-in
$873k $1.28M +$402.18k/hr 1 dispenser on a 4gt clock = 18,000 bone meal/hr. Scale by dispenser count — a 30×30 platform at pitch 9 holds 9 of them. Platform: grass blocks only (dirt/podzol/moss all give ~0.3/bm), clear radius ≥6 around each dispenser, and sit ≥7 blocks inside the cherry-grove border. Pitch 9 is the sweet spot — 7.196 petals/bm, the tightest spacing that still saturates. The harvester MUST fully clear the plant layer between every shot. Bone meals per clear: 1 → +$48.77/bm, 2 → +$18.78, 3 → +$4.57, 4 → −$4.28. A clock that outruns the harvester turns the whole build negative — it is the single biggest lever here. The exit box is pinned to selling petals raw: pink dye's $30 top bid is only 626 units deep and the solver is depth-blind. Click 📌 to unpin if the dye book ever really overtakes. Measured yield: 7.19387 pink petals + 2.51636 wheat seeds per bone meal. Both sell lines are ∞ npc, so the sustainable floor is the NPC price, not the top of book.
